people.name: Ahikam
people.line: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Baalis
people.line: King of the Ammonites during the Babylonian exile.

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

translations.web: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.
